name: Extended Animal Focus
source: Ultimate Wilderness pg. 111, Advanced Class Guide pg. 146
body:
Source Ultimate Wilderness pg. 111, Advanced Class Guide pg. 146
You can assume the aspects of an animal for longer stretches of time than most of your rivals and allies.

Prerequisites: Animal focus class feature.

Benefit: Add your Wisdom bonus (minimum 1) to the number of minutes per day that you can use your animal focus ability to assume the aspects of an animal.
